summary: All three blocking findings are valid and can be repaired by small spec.json changes.

items.title: Disambiguate impl-gate phases
items.rationale: The spec must explicitly include both `task-impl` and `integration` because the existing gate phase surface and retry/artifact behavior are phase keyed.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[0] identifies `task-impl` as an existing public gate phase omitted from R7 and ambiguous in R6.

items.title: Define lint readiness evidence for implement completion
items.rationale: The spec must use an observable completion fixture. Since existing lint readiness has no durable artifact, implement completion should require current flow-visible data only and exclude lint readiness until a durable evidence path exists.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[1] states that tests cannot construct lint readiness fixtures without an observable data path.

items.title: Specify spec-review source finding extraction
items.rationale: The spec-review deferral path must name the real source artifact shape so implementation and tests do not rely on a normalized fixture that production does not write.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[2] states that spec-review writes current findings under `blocking[]` or needs stable ids synthesized from current artifact records.
